notes.title: Girl Amazon Survival Private Alpha has already started!
notes.content:
Hi everyone and thank you for participating in the Girl Amazon Survival Private Alpha! 

Find opponents in the official group
If you're having trouble finding players, please join the official Girl Amazon Survival Steam Group - and add other members as friends to invite into a game. 

The purpose of the alpha test - find bugs
If you find any bug, please report it on the forum.

Suggest your ideas for the game!
If you have any idea for the Girl Amazon Survival, report it on the forum.
All the ideas we take to examining.

Thank you for being with us, Kobra Studio.
